svg.title: How Pill moves money and uses models: one tablet is measured, deterministic code gives one of three answers, the policy agent turns the answer plus the recall lookup, the bottle label, the invoice cap and the pharmacist's tap into release, hold or escalate, and USDC moves between three Coinbase CDP server wallets on Base Sepolia (TESTNET, simulated until a CDP key). Under it, selling a verdict over Coinbase x402: a real 402 today, the paid 200 pending a CDP key.

Station: reads the bottle label and imprint, writes the report, answers Ask, behind the guardrail. Clinic: the two-sentence
“why”; the escrow clerk (returns the ceiling computed in code, or escalate).
Clinic: reads the bottle label into editable fields (unreadable → null); runs the agentic checker (label, up to three cup
frames, code tools for the recall lookup).
Sets a verdict; invents a field
analysis.py and rules.ts (U1 U2 U3 N1 N2 N3 P1) set every verdict; the policy computes the ceiling; the clause filter drops any
model sentence with a banned claim word (more than half dropped → rule text instead).
